(Currently amended) Claim 1: A cooling system installable within a structure wall, comprising: in a housing, the housing disposed between a pair of studs of the wall, a water reservoir; a pump; a pad; a water distributor; a motor; and a fan, wherein the studs are spaced at least sixteen inches on center.

(Currently amended) Claim 4: The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the pump brings water from the water reservoir to the water distributor and the water distributor distributes the water to the pad thereby moistening the pad, and wherein at least some of the water flows back to the reservoir for recirculation.

(Currently amended) Claim 6: The cooling system of claim 5, wherein the fan causes the cooled air to flow through an opening located in a wall of the housing.

(Currently amended) Claim 11: The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the housing includes a front cover that is removable for servicing.

(Currently amended) Claim 2: The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the studs are spaced no less than sixteen inches on center.

(Currently amended) Claim 18: The cooling system of claim 17, wherein the means for mounting includes placing the means for evaporatively cooling within a structure wall, the structure wall constructed using one of structural insulated panels (SIP) and insulating concrete forms (ICF) and includes means for securing the evaporative cooling system between wall studs spaced no less than sixteen inches on center.
